---
title: "What peak roll rate does the biplane cellule achieve compared with the monoplane?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 37.3      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Assemble aerodynamic models with equal total aileron area (76.7 cm2)
delta_throw_deg = 12.0
models = build_aileron_airplanes(delta_a_deg=delta_throw_deg)

# Airspeeds: top speeds from previous entries
v_top_m = 150.4 / 3.6
v_top_b = 149.7 / 3.6

# Evaluate roll stability derivatives and steady roll rates
perf_m = evaluate_roll_performance(models["monoplane"], v_top_m, b_ref=0.622, delta_a_deg=delta_throw_deg)
perf_b4 = evaluate_roll_performance(models["biplane_4ail"], v_top_b, b_ref=0.440, delta_a_deg=delta_throw_deg)
perf_b2 = evaluate_roll_performance(models["biplane_2ail"], v_top_b, b_ref=0.440, delta_a_deg=delta_throw_deg)

p_mono_deg = perf_m["p_nonlin_deg"]
p_bi4_deg = perf_b4["p_nonlin_deg"]
p_bi2_deg = perf_b2["p_nonlin_deg"]

delta_p_deg = p_bi4_deg - p_mono_deg
delta_p_pct = (delta_p_deg / p_mono_deg) * 100

delta_p2_deg = p_bi2_deg - p_mono_deg
delta_p2_pct = (delta_p2_deg / p_mono_deg) * 100

s_ail_m = models["monoplane"].wings[0].control_surface_area()

# Airspeed sweep for visual comparison
v_sweep_kmh = np.linspace(30.0, 160.0, 30)
v_sweep_ms = v_sweep_kmh / 3.6
p_sweep_m = np.degrees(abs(perf_m["pb_2v_lin"]) * (2.0 * v_sweep_ms / 0.622))
p_sweep_b4 = np.degrees(abs(perf_b4["pb_2v_lin"]) * (2.0 * v_sweep_ms / 0.440))
p_sweep_b2 = np.degrees(abs(perf_b2["pb_2v_lin"]) * (2.0 * v_sweep_ms / 0.440))
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{p_bi4_deg:.0f} vs {p_mono_deg:.0f} deg/s"`]{.hero-value}
[Peak roll rate: 4-aileron biplane versus monoplane at level top speed]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** At equal total aileron area ([`{python} f"{s_ail_m*1e4:.1f} cm²"`]{.key}), the four-aileron biplane achieves a peak roll rate of [`{python} f"{p_bi4_deg:.0f}°/s"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{p_bi4_deg/360:.2f} rev/s"`]{.key}) at its [`{python} f"{v_top_b*3.6:.1f} km/h"`]{.key} [calibrated top speed](2026-10-02-01-how-do-a-biplane-variant-s-stall-speed-and-top-speed-compare-with-the.qmd). This is [`{python} f"{delta_p_deg:+.0f}°/s"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{delta_p_pct:+.1f}%"`]{.key}) faster than the monoplane's [`{python} f"{p_mono_deg:.0f}°/s"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{p_mono_deg/360:.2f} rev/s"`]{.key}). Because dimensional roll damping scales with span squared ($L_p \propto b^2$), the shorter cellule reduces roll damping faster than aileron moment arm, boosting the steady roll rate. If ailerons are restricted to two panels on the lower wing, roll rate drops to [`{python} f"{p_bi2_deg:.0f}°/s"`]{.key} due to flap saturation (@fig-roll-rate-comparison).

::: {.callout-tip}
## New user specifications
1. **biplane ailerons: four panels**, upper and lower wings.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **aileron size: 25% chord**, 50% to 95% span.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-roll-rate-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Steady roll rate across airspeed (left) and roll rate comparison at level-flight top speed (right) for the biplane variant versus the monoplane."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.5, 3.8))

# Left panel: Roll rate vs Airspeed sweep
ax1.plot(v_sweep_kmh, p_sweep_m, "r--", lw=1.8, label="Monoplane (622 mm, 2 ailerons)")
ax1.plot(v_sweep_kmh, p_sweep_b4, "b-", lw=2.0, label="Biplane (440 mm, 4 ailerons)")
ax1.plot(v_sweep_kmh, p_sweep_b2, "c-.", lw=1.5, label="Biplane (440 mm, 2 ailerons)")
ax1.plot(v_top_m * 3.6, p_mono_deg, "ro", ms=6)
ax1.plot(v_top_b * 3.6, p_bi4_deg, "bo", ms=6)
ax1.plot(v_top_b * 3.6, p_bi2_deg, "co", ms=5)
ax1.set_xlabel("Airspeed [km/h]")
ax1.set_ylabel("Steady roll rate $p$ [deg/s]")
ax1.set_xlim(30, 165)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 2200)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=7.5)

# Right panel: Bar chart comparison at top speed
configs = ["Monoplane\n(2 ailerons)", "Biplane\n(2 ailerons)", "Biplane\n(4 ailerons)"]
p_vals = [p_mono_deg, p_bi2_deg, p_bi4_deg]
colors = ["#d95f02", "#1b9e77", "#7570b3"]
bars = ax2.bar(configs, p_vals, color=colors, width=0.55, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.8)
ax2.set_ylabel("Peak roll rate at $V_{top}$ [deg/s]")
ax2.set_ylim(0, 2300)
ax2.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)

for bar, p_val in zip(bars, p_vals):
    yval = bar.get_height()
    revs = p_val / 360.0
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2.0, yval + 40, f"{p_val:.0f}°/s\n({revs:.1f} rps)", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
